保存多组像素宽高，供不同生图 API 复用。漫游时可从中随机抽取。: Save pixel sizes for multiple image APIs to share. Roam can pick a size at random.
使用当前生图 API 关联的画幅池；未关联时沿用 API 固定尺寸。: Use the current image API’s canvas pool, or its fixed size when no pool is linked.
使用画幅池时，请同时绑定宽度和高度输入。: Bind both width and height inputs to use a canvas pool.
此接口使用比例和分辨率档位，暂不支持像素画幅池。: This API uses ratio and resolution options and does not support pixel-size pools yet.
默认工作流可直接使用；自定义工作流需绑定宽高输入。宽高须为 8 的倍数。: Default workflows are ready to use. Custom workflows need width and height bindings. Both dimensions must be divisible by 8.
漫游可随机抽取池内尺寸，尺寸需符合当前模型要求。: Roam can pick a size from this pool. Sizes must meet the selected model’s requirements.
请输入画幅池名称，最多 100 个字符。: Enter a canvas pool name (up to 100 characters).
画幅池需要 1–64 组像素尺寸。: A canvas pool needs 1 to 64 pixel sizes.
宽度和高度须为 1–16384 之间的整数像素。: Width and height must be integers from 1 to 16384 pixels.
请移除画幅池中重复的尺寸。: Remove duplicate pixel sizes from the canvas pool.
此画幅池正被生图 API 使用，请先更换关联。: This canvas pool is used by an image API. Change its selection first.
此画幅池需要为每个关联的生图 API 保留至少一组可用尺寸。: This pool needs a usable pixel size for every linked image API.
当前生图 API 在画幅池中没有可用尺寸。: The canvas pool has no usable pixel sizes for this image API.
画幅池中没有可用尺寸。ComfyUI 宽高须为 8 的倍数。: The canvas pool has no usable pixel sizes. ComfyUI needs multiples of 8.
此 API 需要宽高输入才能使用像素画幅池。: This API needs width and height inputs to use a pixel-size pool.
请同时绑定宽度和高度输入。: Bind both width and height inputs.
种子、宽度和高度必须绑定到不同的输入。: Seed, width and height bindings must target different inputs.
ComfyUI 宽高须为 8–16384 之间的 8 的倍数。: ComfyUI width and height must be multiples of 8 from 8 to 16384 pixels.
此 API 需要有效的像素宽度和高度。: This API needs a valid pixel width and height.
在生图 API 中关联画幅池后，可选择像素尺寸。: Link a canvas pool in Image API settings to choose pixel sizes.
当前生图 API 不支持所选像素尺寸。: This image API does not support the requested pixel size.
请同时提供 1–16384 之间的整数宽度和高度。: Specify both width and height as integers from 1 to 16384 pixels.
